rules._comment: Recurring signals, expanded to per-date flags at query time by engine/rules.py. Account-specific response coefficients (median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days, engine/baseline.py baselines) are computed by `python -m engine.rules` when a rule has >= 4 occurrences inside the data window; otherwise coefficient stays null and the rule is prior-only (anti-horoscope rule).

payday_1st.name: Payday: 1st of month
payday_1st.mechanism: Salary/benefits liquidity spike around the 1st; plausible CVR/demand lift.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

payday_15th.name: Payday: 15th of month
payday_15th.mechanism: Semi-monthly payroll liquidity spike; plausible CVR/demand lift.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

month_end.name: Month end (last calendar day)
month_end.mechanism: Pre-payday liquidity trough + advertiser-side monthly budget exhaustion/reset effects on auction (also plausibly EXTERNAL_AUCTION via competitor budget cycling).

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

snap_window.name: SNAP issuance window (days 1-10, US aggregate approximation)
snap_window.mechanism: SNAP benefits issue on state-staggered schedules concentrated early in the month; aggregate US liquidity gradient across the month. APPROXIMATION: several states stagger through day 20+; state-level precision requires audience-geo data we do not have.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

federal_holiday.name: US federal holiday (class)
federal_holiday.mechanism: Routine/attention displacement; retail demand may rise or fall by holiday type. CLASS COEFFICIENT ONLY: pooling Thanksgiving with MLK Day is heterogeneous — treat the pooled coefficient as a weak prior, individual holidays have n=1 each.
federal_holiday.machine_check: statutory dates: 4th Thu Nov 2025=11-27, Dec 25, Jan 1, 3rd Mon Jan 2026=01-19, 3rd Mon Feb=02-16, last Mon May=05-25, Jun 19

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days
